overview.description: The Harbor Active Commodity ETF (ACOM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad market commodities. The fund is an actively managed commodity ETF, providing long-only exposure to commodity-linked derivative instruments. The fund seeks total return. ACOM was launched on Jun 16, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.
